newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ForBio buys British seed producer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ForBio buys British seed producer.

text.p: ForBio Ltd said on Wednesday it had acquired unlisted British seed producer International Plant Laboratories Ltd (IPL) for about 2.5 million pounds sterling and the assumption of IPL's liabilities.
IPL was the largest producer of tissue cultured plants in Britain and the world's fifth largest, with more than 60 staff and freehold premises near Bristol, ForBio said.

Forbio said it planned to use IPL as its base for expansion in Europe, Africa and the Middle East, and would expand IPL's product base by introducing robotics and ForBio's plants to IPL's markets. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
